profile.headline: Software engineer at Adobe
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer / Applied AI Engineer
profile.summary:
Applied AI and full-stack engineer with 17+ years across product engineering and customer-facing solutions roles. Takes LLM systems from prototype to production inside large organizations. Owns the full build, backend services, LLM pipelines, orchestration, and front-end integration. Earlier career in pre-sales solutions engineering and solutions architecture, embedded directly with enterprise customers to scope, build, and integrate products into their environments.

Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Redux, Adobe Spectrum 
Backend & AI: Node.js, Python, LLM Fine-Tuning (Gemma), Generative AI (Firefly), Search Optimization Cloud: AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2), Serverless, Terraform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Applied AI Engineer
positions.description:
Architecting next-generation discovery experiences, fluid canvas interfaces, and intelligent orchestration layers within the Adobe Express and Adobe Stock ecosystems.

• Core Focus: Leading the technical discovery, architecture, and deployment of large language model (LLM) integrations, including intent classification systems using internally hosted models (Gemma/Firefly) to drive product roadmaps across teams.
• Systems & Scale: Spearheading cross-functional implementations of intelligent planner intents, search routing sub-agents, conversational UI frameworks, and mobile-first AI workflows to reduce friction for millions of creators.
• Technical Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, Apollo Client, Node.js, AWS, Styled Components, Framer Motion, and Adobe Spectrum tokens.
positions.insights: Skills: Generative AI · React.js · Next.js · Large Language Models (LLM) · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered massive-scale infrastructure and unified frontend ecosystems for a highly customizable e-commerce and donation platform.

• Systems & Scale: Developed and optimized scalable frontend architectures utilizing React, Next.js, and an AWS serverless backbone, supporting system performance during massive spikes of up to 5,000,000 daily transactions.
• Design Systems: Designed and deployed a comprehensive component library integrating Material UI and SLDS to accelerate engineering velocity across multiple product teams and ensure global UI consistency.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Distributed Systems · React.js · Next.js · Network Security · Node.js · Design Systems

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the frontend architecture and hardware automation pipelines for competitive track-side operations.

• Real-Time Data: Spearheaded the development of web applications for real-time NASCAR team race strategy, utilizing React and Material UI to fluidly render complex, fast-changing data streams so crews could make critical in-race adjustments.
• Hardware Automation: Led high-impact hardware automation projects simulating race conditions with pressure and heat testing sensors in industrial simulation environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Full-Stack Architecture: Designed and developed a full-stack Medicare tier payout scoring engine using Node.js, Express, and React, delivering seamless cross-team UI layouts and highly performant API integrations for hospital groups and individual practices.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead efforts to build a niche marketplace e-commerce platform for the game & hobby industry.  Maintained and refactored legacy point of sale, supply chain & inventory management apps increase performance and usability.

Frontend development with React.js, Redux, Zurb Foundation.

Backend: Node.js, Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Enterprise SaaS product development: Built responsive, interactive interfaces for next-generation enterprise accounting and expense management software using Backbone.js, Marionette.js, Handlebars.js, Thymeleaf, Sass, and HTML5.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description: Ran an independent search marketing practice for mid-market and enterprise clients — managed campaigns end to end and built the landing pages, product sites, and custom web assets behind them.

positions.title: Sales Engineer
positions.description: Full-cycle sales engineering for enterprise accounts: ran pre-sales demos alongside account executives, then built and delivered the implementation, SEO microsites for customer product pages and data integrations feeding local.com advertising campaigns.
